title: lineage-finding.v1
description: S033 lineage-extract-static per-chunk emission from the in-session AI CLI's LLM analysis. Captures data-flow edges (reads_from / writes_to / schedules / depends_on) with confidence classification (grounded / inferred / speculative) and gap[] entries for honest disclosure of static-analysis lossiness. Used at chunk-level (single chunk of a file) AND at file-level (rollup from accumulate after merge-chunks-within-file). Validated by scripts/validate_finding.py before accumulation and before OL emission.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path of the analyzed file. Path separator is forward slash on all platforms.

file_sha256.description: sha256 of the entire file content (NOT the chunk).

chunk_id.description: 1-indexed chunk number within the file. 1 always for single-chunk (inline) files; 0 reserved for file-level rollups produced by accumulate.

start_line.description: 1-indexed start line of this chunk within the file.

end_line.description: 1-indexed end line of this chunk within the file (inclusive).

start_byte.description: 0-indexed start byte of this chunk within the file.

end_byte.description: 0-indexed end byte of this chunk within the file (exclusive, like Python slice end).

boundary_status.description: Whether the chunk ends mid-statement. 'complete' means clean boundaries on both ends. 'partial_start' means the chunk begins inside a statement that started earlier. 'partial_end' means a statement was open at chunk end. 'partial_both' means both. Used by merge-chunks-within-file prompt to pair adjacent partials. Always 'complete' for inline (single-chunk) files.

edges.description: Data-flow edges extracted from the chunk. Empty array is valid (chunk contained no lineage-relevant statements).

edge_kind.description: Closed enum. reads_from = job consumes dataset as input. writes_to = job produces dataset as output. schedules = scheduler triggers job. depends_on = job has downstream-task dependency.

namespace.description: URI scheme + authority. Examples: 'postgres://dwh:5432/analytics', 'file://repo', 's3://acme-data'. Resolved via 3-step waterfall in resolve-identity prompt BEFORE OL emission.

kind.description: Dataset taxonomy for renderer node-shape selection.

namespace.description: Repo-relative path or DAG id. Examples: 'repo://my-project', 'airflow://prod/users_dag'.

name.description: Symbol or task id within the namespace. Examples: 'etl/load_users.py:main', 'load_users_task'.

kind.description: Job taxonomy. Maps to OL Job.facets at emission time.

evidence_line_start.description: 1-indexed line number where evidence begins (relative to the file, not the chunk).

evidence_line_end.description: 1-indexed line number where evidence ends (relative to the file, not the chunk; inclusive).

evidence_snippet.description: Verbatim text from the file showing the lineage statement (e.g. `df = pd.read_csv(USERS_PATH)`). MUST NOT contain credentials per HARD-RULE 4 — LLM is instructed to omit creds, and redact.py provides a second pass.

confidence.description: Bright-line classifier per HARD-RULE 2. grounded = literal string + symbols resolve in local context. inferred = name-resolution heuristic (env-var resolved, CTE alias). speculative = string interpolation OR unresolved symbol OR SELECT * OR basename-only match. f-string / .format() / %-format / env-var template = ALWAYS speculative.

confidence_reason.description: One-line explanation of why this confidence tier applies. Examples: 'literal string path', 'env-var resolved against .env', 'f-string interpolation within 5 lines', 'basename-only match'.

boundary_issue.description: True iff this edge was emitted from an unpaired partial chunk. accumulate.py sets this when boundary_matching predicate cannot pair partials; the edge is forced to speculative confidence. Optional; default false.

gaps.description: Honest disclosure of points where static analysis is fundamentally lossy. NOT errors — gaps say 'I saw something but cannot extract a confident edge'.

kind.description: Closed enum. dynamic_path = f-string / template path. unresolved_symbol = name not resolvable in chunk. obfuscated = encoded / minified. binary_file = chunk_file detected non-text. language_unsupported = LLM has no extraction prompt for this format. oversized_file = file exceeded LINEAGE_HARD_FILE_LIMIT_MB. redaction_applied = redact.py replaced content.

line.description: 1-indexed line of the gap site (file-relative, not chunk-relative).

description.description: One-line explanation. Examples: 'path = f"{base_dir}/{filename}" — interpolation', 'function arg resolved upstream, not in chunk', 'PE binary signature detected at offset 0'.

by_confidence.description: OPTIONAL counters surfaced by accumulate.py at file-level rollup. Sum of children edges grouped by confidence tier. Absent at chunk-level emission.

by_kind.description: OPTIONAL counters surfaced by accumulate.py at file-level rollup. Sum of children edges grouped by edge_kind.

boundary_issues_count.description: OPTIONAL count of edges with boundary_issue=true. Surfaced by accumulate.py at file-level rollup; absent at chunk-level.

dataset_schemas.description: OPTIONAL (2026-07-01 schema-facet uplift). Column/field structure for datasets whose columns are NAMED IN SOURCE (dbt schema.yml models, SQL DDL column lists, CSV header rows, COBOL copybook fields, staged-model SELECT column lists). NEVER invented or guessed columns — speculative columns are OMITTED, not banded. Flows through accumulate.py + merge-across-files into the project aggregate; merge_into_ol.py attaches each entry as an OpenLineage SchemaDatasetFacet (facets.schema.fields) on the matching DatasetEvent.

namespace.description: Same namespace vocabulary as edges[].source_dataset.namespace — MUST match the dataset it describes so OL emission can join them.

fields.description: Ordered column/field list AS NAMED IN SOURCE (source order preserved).

type.description: Optional — only when the type is stated in source (DDL type, schema.yml data_type, copybook PIC). Omit when not stated; never guess.

description.description: Optional (2026-07-02 column-level uplift) — only when the source states a column/field description (dbt schema.yml column description, copybook comment). Never invented.

evidence_line.description: Optional 1-indexed file-relative line where the column list is declared.

column_lineage.description: OPTIONAL (2026-07-02 column-level uplift). Per-column derivations for OUTPUT datasets whose column mapping is NAMED IN SOURCE (SQL rename lists, explicit passthrough columns, expressions naming their source columns). STRICT: a mapping exists only when the source names both ends; SELECT * and unresolved macros yield NOTHING for that field — EXCEPT the single-parent identity-passthrough marker (passthrough_from), which merge_into_ol.py expands deterministically against the parent's named dataset_schemas entry iff the producing job has exactly ONE input dataset. Flows through accumulate.py + merge-across-files into the project aggregate; merge_into_ol.py attaches each resolved entry as an OpenLineage columnLineage 1-2-0 facet on the matching OUTPUT DatasetEvent.

namespace.description: OUTPUT dataset namespace — same vocabulary as edges[].source_dataset.namespace.

fields.description: columnLineage 1-2-0 field map: {<output_field>: {inputFields: [{namespace, name, field}]}}. Mutually exclusive with passthrough_from.

passthrough_from.description: SELECT-* single-parent identity-passthrough marker (§9 amendment): the output is a plain `select * from <single upstream>`. merge_into_ol.py expands it to a 1:1 identity field map from the parent's named dataset_schemas entry; unknown parent schema or a multi-input producing job yields NOTHING.

evidence_line.description: Optional 1-indexed file-relative line of the defining statement.

dataset_descriptions.description: OPTIONAL (2026-07-02 column-level uplift). Dataset-level descriptions stated in source (dbt model/source description:, table comment DDL). merge_into_ol.py attaches each as an OpenLineage documentation facet on the matching DatasetEvent. Never invented.
